chunks: My father (peace be upon him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me, who said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated to us from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Sayf ibn Amirah, from Abdillah ibn Ubaydillah, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: When the month of Ramadan approached, with three days remaining from Sha'ban, he said to Bilal: 'Call the people.' So the people were gathered. Then he ascended the pulpit, praised Allah and extolled Him, then said: 'O people, this is a month that has come to you, and it is the master of months. In it is the Night of Power, which is better than a thousand months. The doors of Hell are closed in it and the doors of Paradise are opened in it. So whoever experiences it and is not forgiven, may Allah distance him. And whoever experiences it and has parents and is not forgiven, may Allah distance him. And when I am mentioned in his presence and he does not send blessings upon me, he is not forgiven, and may Allah distance him.'
ai.seo_question: What are the virtues of Ramadan and the consequences of not seeking forgiveness during this month according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A'mal* underscores the unique spiritual gravity of Ramadan as 'the master of months,' linking the closing of Hell and opening of Paradise directly to divine mercy rather than mere ritual. It uniquely integrates three specific conditions for forgiveness—general mercy, filial piety, and salawat upon the Prophet—highlighting the Shia emphasis on the interconnection of worship, family rights, and prophetic love. The narration serves as a practical guide for believers to maximize their spiritual gain during the final days of Sha'ban and the entirety of Ramadan.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 8.  Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.) narrates that the month of Ramadan was nearing and three days of Shaban were left when  the  Holy  Prophet  (s.a.w.s.)  told  Bilal  (r.a.)  to  call people  to  him.  When  people  came,  the  Holy  Prophet (s.a.w.s.) mounted the pulpit and praised and glorified the Lord. Then he  said, “The  month, which you are  going  to have now is supreme among all other months. There is a night in this month, which is better than a thousand months. The doors of Hell are closed in this month and the doors of Paradise are opened. One who is not forgiven in this month also  then  Allah  distances  him.  Similarly  if  a  person  has parents and is not able to get himself forgiven then Allah distances him. One who does not recite Salawat when I am mentioned in front of him, his salvation is not possible and Allah distances him.”
